title: Linear Actuator & Ball Screw Price Pakistan 2026 — Electric vs Pneumatic vs Hydraulic, Ball Screw vs Lead Screw, Stroke Force & CNC Retrofit Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete linear actuator and ball screw buying guide Pakistan 2026: electric vs pneumatic vs hydraulic actuator selection decision matrix, ball screw vs lead screw vs rack-and-pinion comparison, PKR 2026 price tables for electric actuators (100N–10,000N) and ball screws (Ø12–Ø50 mm C7/C5 grade), stroke length and force calculation with Pakistan load-shedding DOL restart factor, 45°C summer thermal derating rules, 5-step CNC machine retrofit methodology for Pakistani machine shops, valve and damper actuator fail-safe requirements, ball screw maintenance for Pakistan dust and heat conditions, 6-test counterfeit ball screw detection guide, 5-city Pakistan sourcing guide, and 10-question buyer checklist.
